SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT

S. 1, Special Branch. Station. File No.................... Date January 16, 1942.

SUBJECT: Park Hotel - unrest

Due to business depression, the Management of
the Park Hotel, 164 Bubbling Well Road decided to
suspend temporarily the services of some 54 employees.
An announcement to this effect was made on January 15.
The employees affected will be granted full pay
including allowances for January and half pay for
the months of February and March. Final decision
as to the discharge of the affected employees will
be made by the management in March next, and will
depend on the business conditions then existing.

In consequence of this decision of the
management, unrest exists among the employees concerned.

（印：FILE 17. 1. 42.）

主题：国际饭店 - 动荡

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SP. BR. REGISTRY No. [手写数字] Date [手写日期]）

S. 1. Special Branch Station. File No.................... Date February 2., 1942.

SUBJECT: Park Hotel - unrest among discharged employees.

Further to Special Branch report dated 30-1-42 and the present deadlock in negotiations between the management and the discharged employees.

During the afternoon of January 31st three of the discharged employees, Woo Zung Sung (吳润生), Fei Sih Sung (費錫生), and Oong An Ding (翁愛廷), assaulted Mr. Herzel, Manager and Mr. Ling Mien Tse (林勉之), Assistant Manager of the Hotel, on the hotel premises, and made good their escape. A party of Police from Sinza Station attended and at the request of the management, arrested seventeen of the other discharged employees, who were later released through lack of evidence as to their participation in the affair. They, however, on the instructions of the management removed from their quarters in the hotel.

On February 1, one Zee Koh Chung (徐可中), member of the Shanghai Municipality Social Movement Direction Committee called upon Mr. Herzel with the intention of mediating in the dispute, but in view of the present attitude of the discharged employees, the manager refused to resume negotiations.

（批：Major Gole 2.2.42 86）

（印：POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH FEB 2 1942）

S. 1. 特别科分站。档案号.................... 日期 1942年2月2日。

主题：国际饭店 - 被解雇雇员中的动荡。

继1942年1月30日的特别科报告之后，鉴于管理层与被解雇雇员之间的谈判目前陷入僵局。

1月31日下午，三名被解雇雇员吴润生 (Woo Zung Sung)、费锡生 (Fei Sih Sung) 和翁爱廷 (Oong An Ding)，在酒店范围内袭击了饭店经理赫泽尔 (Herzel) 先生和副经理林勉之 (Ling Mien Tse) 先生，随后逃脱。新闸捕房的一队警察到场，应管理层要求，逮捕了其他十七名被解雇雇员，后因缺乏其参与此事的证据而获释。然而，他们根据管理层的指示，搬离了他们在酒店内的宿舍。

2月1日，上海市社会运动指导委员会成员徐可中 (Zee Koh Chung) 拜访了赫泽尔先生，意图调解纠纷，但鉴于被解雇雇员目前的态度，经理拒绝恢复谈判。

（批注：戈尔少校 1942年2月2日 86）

REPORT

S.1, Special Branch Station: // File No.................... Date January 30, 1942.

SUBJECT: Park Hotel - unrest among discharged employees

On January 16, the management of the Park Hotel, 164 Bubbling Well Road, suspended the services of 54 of their employees due to business depression. The employees affected were promised full pay including allowances for January, and half pay for the month of February. The management further announced that a final decision as to the discharge of those affected will be made at the end of February. The employees concerned were dissatisfied with this offer and requested the following :-

(1) That the affected employees be accorded normal treatment and provided food and lodging during the period of suspension.

(2) That the surcharge for the month of February be issued as usual, the employees concerned agreeing to accept half pay in respect of wages and allowances.

(3) That after February, the affected employees continue to be granted similar treatment to that accorded in February, pending resumption of duty.

In the event of the management not agreeing to these demands, the employees requested discharge on the following terms:-

(1) That the affected employees be given double pay for December, 1941, as an annual bonus.

(2) That they be granted full pay for the month of January, and half pay including allowances and surcharges for February.

(3) That discharge gratuities be issued according to years of service, i.e. for every year of service,

S.1，特别科分站：// 档案号.................... 日期 1942年1月30日。

主题：国际饭店 - 被解雇雇员中的动荡

1月16日，静安寺路164号国际饭店管理层因商业萧条暂停了54名雇员的服务。承诺给予受影响雇员一月份的全薪（包括津贴），以及二月份的半薪。管理层进一步宣布，关于解雇受影响雇员的最终决定将在二月底作出。相关雇员对此提议不满，并提出以下要求：-

(1) 在停职期间，给予受影响雇员正常待遇，并提供食宿。

(2) 照常发放二月份的附加费，相关雇员同意接受工资和津贴的半薪。

(3) 二月之后，在复职之前，继续给予受影响雇员与二月份类似的待遇。

如果管理层不同意这些要求，雇员请求按以下条件解雇：-

(1) 将1941年12月的双倍工资作为年终奖金发给受影响雇员。

(2) 给予一月份全薪，以及二月份包括津贴和附加费在内的半薪。

(3) 根据服务年限发放解雇酬金，即每服务一年，

The first set of demands were not agreeable to
the management who, however, agreed to the first and
second items of the latter demands, but promised only
three months' pay, excluding rice allowance, as
discharge gratuities. Negotiations between the
management and the employees failed to bring about a
settlement.
On the morning of January 29, four representa-
tives of the employees concerned called upon Mr. P.Y.Koo
of the Industrial Section and then came to the Special
Branch, and reported on the situation of the negotiations.
At 2.30 p.m., the undersigned and D.S.I. Loh Wei Kong
accompanied by Mr. P.Y. Koo of the Industrial Section
proceeded to the Park Hotel with a view to obtaining an
amicable settlement of the negotiation between the
management and the employees concerned. The
representatives of the parties were as follows:-

SUBJECT:
Although the matter was thoroughly discussed
neither side appeared to be inclined to alter their
terms, whereon a deadlock was reached. They were,
however, advised to reconsider their decisions.
On the morning of January 30, the employees' delegates
informed the Special Branch by telephone that they
were still not inclined to modify their demands. This
information was accordingly conveyed to the management.
It is learned that the management is prepared to order
the affected employees to remove from the hotel staff
quarters and to discontinue their food supply. No
further mediation is considered advisable at present,
pending concessions being made by one or both parties.
It is reported that unrest exists among a
number of employees whose services are still retained,
in view of possible suspension or discharge by the
management on account of the latter's retrenchment
policy.
（批：1/31）

分站。档案号.................... 日期....................
主题：
尽管进行了充分讨论，但双方似乎都不愿改变其
条件，从而陷入僵局。不过，建议他们重新考虑其决定。
1月30日上午，雇员代表通过电话通知特别科，他们
仍不愿修改其要求。此信息随即转达给管理层。
据悉，管理层准备命令受影响雇员搬离酒店员工
宿舍，并停止供应食物。目前认为不宜进行进一步调解，
以待一方或双方作出让步。
据报道，由于管理层实行紧缩政策可能导致停职或解雇，
许多仍被留用的雇员中存在不安情绪。
（批注：1/31）

January 30, 42.
2.

Labour dispute at the Park Hotel.

On the afternoon of 30/1/42, a meeting was held
in the staff mess room of the Park Hotel, Bubbling
Well Road, which was attended by some 60 employees
of the hotel. Amongst the participants in the
meeting, some 55 were employees who are not affected
by "Suspension" whilst the remaining 5 are amongst
the 35 employees whose temporary suspension, owing to
depressed business, will come into effect on and from
1/2/42. The latter are thought by the management
of the Hotel to be attempting to influence the hotel
employees to take part in the present dispute between
the management and the 35 employees whose temporary
suspension has already been decided upon by the
management.

The object of the meeting is said to be in regard
to the amount of "annual bonus" for the current year
issuable at the end of the Chinese new year.

There was no untoward incident.

Copy to Special Branch.

（批：Major Yole and S.I 31.1.42 G.L.）

2.

国际饭店劳资纠纷。

1942年1月30日下午，在静安寺路国际饭店的员工食堂举行了一次会议，约有60名酒店雇员参加。与会者中，约55人是未受“停职”影响的雇员，其余5人属于因业务低迷而将于1942年2月1日起暂时停职的35名雇员之列。酒店管理层认为，后者正试图影响酒店雇员参与当前管理层与这35名已被管理层决定暂时停职的雇员之间的纠纷。

据说会议的目的是关于农历年末发放的当年“年终奖金”数额。

未发生不良事件。

抄送特别科。
